name: Patient Representative Certificate (C25310PR)
sourceWorkbook: College of The Albemarle: the 2026–27 Academic Catalog pages for Medical Office Administration (pp. 196–200 — the AAS, Diploma, Patient Representative Certificate and CCP pathway sequences, hours, credits and prerequisites; received 2026-11-12) and the program coordinator's filled Program Planning Template (the twelve core courses' session rows, received 2026-11-12); the college's 2026–27 academic calendar page and location pages — compiled 2026-11-12
note: The Patient Representative Certificate as the 2026–27 catalog sequences it (the college lists it as fully online): CIS 111, MED 121, MED 130 and BUS 151, then MED 122, MED 118 and OST 164 — the core courses on the coordinator's own session rows (MED 130's Tuesday lab in Owens 211 included), the others at the catalog's hours. The catalog's total of 18 holds with MED 118 at 2 credits (its certificate table prints 3, its AAS table 2 — the workbook's hours and the state library say 2). Class size 25 (the rows' caps; MED 118's 30). Faculty policy as the sheet gives it: 2.22 = 40 ÷ 18 ("FT = 18/20 = 2.22" — 18 contact hours of a 40-hour week) or 1 where the sheet says an adjunct teaches (1:1).
weeklyHoursNote: Hours per student: the twelve core courses are the college's own session rows, carried row for row (each course's weekly fields are its rows' totals ÷ 16; online rows have no day or time, the in-person labs sit on their posted Tuesday block); the catalog's other courses carry their printed hours as one row a week with no section on record; WBL 111 is 10 work-based hours a week. Credits are the 2026–27 catalog's.
